text: Ok I've been trying to get through for ages and nobody's picked up so I'm just going to type it all out here. My sister is 6. Mum's on a night shift and I've been looking after her since teatime. She had a temperature earlier, I took it again just now and it's 38.4. Her eczema's flared up again too, the dry itchy patches on the backs of her knees and inside her elbows. She's been scratching them all evening, which is pretty normal for her when she's run down. What's not normal is that she's really sleepy and floppy. I went in to give her a drink and I could barely wake her up. Usually she'd be moaning at me to go away but she just kind of lay there and didn't really react to me at all, like she wasn't properly there. I've tried ringing mum but her phone's off at work. I'm 16 and I don't know if I'm meant to be calling someone else or what, so can someone actually get back to me please.
